scenario_text: A fintech startup wants to launch a personal loan app for young professionals. They want quick disbursal, maybe under 10 minutes. The product team is small — 3 people — and the CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months, then iterate based on user feedback. Requirements will definitely change as they learn what users want.

requirements.statement: The system shall disburse loans within 10 minutes of approval
requirements.business_justification: Quick disbursal increases customer satisfaction and reduces loan application abandonment rates
requirements.assumptions: Loan approval process is automated and does not require manual intervention
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Loan disbursal occurs within 10 minutes of approval, as measured by system logs

requirements.statement: The system shall support iterative development and deployment
requirements.business_justification: Requirements will change as we learn from user feedback; iterative development enables rapid adaptation
requirements.assumptions: Development team has experience with agile methodologies
requirements.acceptance_criteria: New features are deployed to production within 1 week of development completion, as measured by version control system

issues.description: The requirement states that the system shall disburse loans within 10 minutes of approval, but the assumption states that the loan approval process is automated and does not require manual intervention. This implies that the system may not be able to disburse loans within 10 minutes if the approval process takes longer than 10 minutes.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the assumption to state that the loan approval process takes less than 10 minutes, or adjust the requirement to account for potential delays in the approval process.
